title: Native Inventory-Reducing DCA Minigrid
native_minigrid_backtest_evidence: Config struct MartingaleDcaMiniGridConfig added to shared-domain with validate(), level_price(), close_fraction() methods. 5 backtest tests pass (validation, price math, symmetry, min-notional check, inventory-reducing semantics).
research_only_reason: The kline_engine.rs (9000+ lines) main simulation loop requires deep integration to emit dca_minigrid_take_profit events during bar processing. The config struct and price/close-fraction math are complete and tested, but the engine integration (placing reduce-only partial closes at minigrid levels during the bar loop) is deferred to avoid destabilizing the validated backtest engine. P4 search uses the config-level minigrid approximation via additional partial TP stages (proven safe in R10 P5).
